name: single-calendar
description: A date-picker calendar variant displaying a single month.

anatomy.name: popover
anatomy.description: Surface that holds the month navigation, weekday labels and day grid.

anatomy.name: month-button
anatomy.description: Chevron button that moves to the previous or next month.

anatomy.name: weekday-label
anatomy.description: Single-letter weekday heading above the day grid.

anatomy.name: day
anatomy.description: One date cell. Styled for selected, error, unavailable and current-day.

anatomy.name: range-fill
anatomy.description: Highlight band behind the days of a selected range.

anatomy.name: help-text
anatomy.description: Error message shown below the calendar when the selection is invalid.

anatomyReview.notes: Figma S2 Web .Calendar popover (Type=Single); relationship part popover. Unsure: whether container is needed.
